transfer_tensors_to_device: recursively move tensors in nested dicts, lists, or tuples to a target device like cuda or cpu
convert_tensors_to_numpy: convert PyTorch tensors to numpy arrays while preserving nested data structure shape
auto_detect_best_device: auto-detect the best available computation device prioritizing CUDA then MPS then CPU
query_device_capabilities: query a device to check if bfloat16 is supported and get the device type string
resolve_mixed_precision_dtype: resolve the best available mixed precision dtype for a device falling back from bf16 to fp16
